 Quick summary - click for full details Concise summary of key highlights Apple to bring redesigned Health app to iPhone and iPads soon
 In one line Apple is launching a redesigned Health app for iPhones and iPads featuring smart Insights, a Longevity tab, and AI-powered movement evaluations. Key points • All-New Insights Tab Automatically surfaces timely, context-relevant widgets and Live Activities, displaying holistic summaries spanning heart, sleep, readiness, and fitness data throughout the day. • Longevity and Health Age Analyzes longitudinal metrics across various health categories and introduces Health Age, translating Apple Watch data into a metric reflecting how the body tracks relative to chronological age. • At-Home Movement Evaluations Utilises the iPhone camera and Apple Watch to measure flexibility, strength, balance, and VO2 max through on-device vision-based AI models without recording or sharing video. • Global Language Expansion Expands support to multiple international languages, bringing personalised health insights to millions of users worldwide as a free software update. Key statistics 12 years Time since Apple Health app debut IOS 27.3 and iPadOS 27.3 Upcoming software update version Processed with AI. Reviewed by DH Digital Team.
